notes.title: Love & Cards Early Access OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone!
Our new game "[b]Love & Cards[/b]" is now available in Early Access![/h2]

[i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017700/Love__Cards/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017700/Love__Cards/[/url][/b][/i]

Set in the same universe as OPT 1 & 2, this new game introduces you to brand-new characters and adventures on the planet New Frontier!
This game is a mix of a visual novel, a card game, a point-and-click, and a romance game! (Yes, a lot all at once!)

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44891385/7cb41f24648a4cdb680f9350fb0df1fe100cae7e.png[/img]

In this first update, which offers nearly an hour of content, you’ll get to experience all the new features we’ve added to the game: improved graphics, more animations, voice-acted dialogues, and much more advanced storytelling than before!

I wish you all an amazing time playing! Don’t hesitate to leave a positive review if you enjoyed it (it helps a lot)!
And most importantly, share your feedback with us! Our goal is to create the best game possible!

Have a great day, everyone!
Bye ~~

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44891385/ca25556b1f37de417c2f633d647560e7df71da57.png[/img]

notes.title: Love and Cards: New Game Coming on January 17
notes.content:
Get ready for our new game: [b]Love and Cards![/b]

"Love and Cards" by OPT Studio invites you to a thrilling, humorous adventure set in the galactic Wild West, a universe of cowboys and aliens in a sci-fi space world!

    - Explore diverse storylines filled with romance, comedy, and unexpected twists.
    - Meet vibrant characters and dive into exciting adventures in New Frontier.
    - Engage in a unique turn-based card system.
    - Customize your character with numerous choices.

The Early Access version of Love and Cards launches on January 17.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017700/Love__Cards/]LOVE & CARDS Steam page Here![/url]

In this first update, you’ll explore the planet New Frontier and dive into a brand-new card game. Enjoy polished 2D graphics, voiced dialogues, and a mix of engaging storylines, romance, and some spicy content for the adventurous!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375170/7cb41f24648a4cdb680f9350fb0df1fe100cae7e.png[/img]

After this first update, you’ll enjoy regular updates that will continue the story, leading up to the final update marking the game’s full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375170/cc584054d29ec9e1afa656bbeb29f82d733117f7.png[/img]

Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist, and I’ll see you on January 17th for the Early Access launch! See you soon, cowpokes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375170/ef6d2fe4c86146079a7e32fa295dec35a5ab19e1.gif[/img]

notes.title: OPT2 Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A quick fix to FINALLY resolve the in-game issue with the guard scene that was overlooked at the game's release. We're currently finishing up a major update that will add the French translation to the game, and if possible, we might also implement a Spanish translation in the future!

To give you some more updates from the Studio, we're still actively working on our next game, currently titled "Porn & Cards," which might soon be renamed to "Love & Cards." The development is going smoothly, and I'm really excited to show you more in the coming weeks.

In the meantime, I wish you all a great time playing the game. Thanks to everyone for your feedback, and see you soon for the French translation and more bug fixes!

Bye ~
